name: Bismuth Android
description: Android ARM64 in-game performance monitor for Geometry Dash 2.2081, with conservative safe-mode renderer diagnostics.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic logging
diagnostics.description: Write Bismuth safe-mode initialization information to the Geode log.

hud-enabled.name: Live performance HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show the top-left in-game monitor. Metrics are limited to values measured by this package.

hud-advanced.name: Advanced monitor
hud-advanced.description: Show frame-interval percentiles, estimated 1% low, CPU update wall time, hitch count, and sample count.

hud-graph.name: Frame cadence graph
hud-graph.description: Show the rolling 24-sample frame-cadence graph in Advanced Monitor.

hud-memory.name: Process memory (RSS)
hud-memory.description: Show resident memory for the whole game process from /proc/self/statm; this is not native-heap-only memory.
